_rules: CB-311's orbweaver-push-v1, unchanged (spikes/ios/vectors/push-v1.json still holds): ephemeral P-256 per push, shared = ECDH(eph, phone agreement key) raw x, key = HKDF-SHA256(shared, salt empty, info = "orbweaver-push-v1" || eph_pub || phone_pub, 32), header = 0x01 || eph_pub (66 bytes) as the AEAD's AAD, e = base64url(header || nonce(12) || ct || tag(16)). e is at most 3600 characters (frames-v3). Fitting (#11248 rev 2): detail = preview cut at 512; if e would exceed 3600, cut detail to the longest prefix that fits (cut text ends in …); if an empty detail still does not fit, cut every label over 120 characters to 119 + … and cut detail again; never drop an option, kind, scope or screen_hash; if it still does not fit, send no e. Lengths are UTF-16 code units, never splitting a surrogate pair.
